typography.label: Typography
typography.citation: A/02.png: the panel's micro-labels "CAPTIONS" and "EXTRAS" are both set at the same ~11px uppercase with ~0.08em tracking, while the six clip titles all sit at 14/19 and their durations all at 13px, so the same kind of value gets the same treatment in every row; B/02.png runs one muted ~13px weight across the breadcrumb, sidebar rows and field labels, so hierarchy there is carried by color, not by type.
typography.why: A has a real scale of four or five sizes with tracked uppercase micro-labels, a consistent heading/body pairing and matching numeric treatment across list rows and the score badge; B is clean but nearly single-size, leaning on gray levels rather than type to separate a heading from its own subtitle.
